items.title: Call to Order / Roll Call (Open Session Reconvene)
Reconvene to Open Session / Roll Call
Report Out on Closed Session from April 22, 2026
Welcome / Pledge of Allegiance
Changes to the Agenda
Approval of the Agenda (Action Required)
Public Comment

publicComments.name: Jenny and Archer
publicComments.summary: Two Orion students expressed concern about the proposed 3rd/4th grade combo class, noting the difference in instruction ratio and asking for two separate 3rd grade classes.

publicComments.name: Allison Rhodes
publicComments.summary: A Clifford Elementary teacher presented a petition outlining concerns about multiple combination classrooms, including doubled teacher workload, lack of instructional aide support, and disproportionate impact on students with IEPs and English learners.

publicComments.name: Andrew Chan
publicComments.summary: An Orion parent of four children praised the Mandarin Immersion program and argued that a 3rd/4th combo class would dilute the critical final year of 60/40 Mandarin instruction, proposing instead that the district recruit enough students to justify two full 3rd grade classes.

publicComments.name: Richard Palm
publicComments.summary: An Orion parent shared that both his daughters have thrived in the MI program, including one with epilepsy who requires hands-on attention, and expressed concern that a combo class would harm students needing individualized support.

publicComments.name: Jason Madsen
publicComments.summary: An Orion parent speaking on behalf of many 2nd grade MI families presented concerns about the proposed 3rd/4th combo class, citing instructional quality, the critical nature of 3rd grade in the immersion sequence, and the impact on students with IEPs, and asked the district to reconsider in favor of two full 3rd grade classes.

publicComments.name: Ann Law
publicComments.summary: A twin mom in the Orion MI program said the combo class proposal would force her to choose which of her twin boys gets the combo placement, and asked the district to reconsider for fairness.

publicComments.name: Julia Redesnerne
publicComments.summary: An Orion parent of a rising 3rd grader and incoming TKer expressed concern that the 31-student combo class would reduce dedicated teacher attention during the critical year for Mandarin literacy development, and warned that some families might leave the program if conditions worsen.

publicComments.name: Heidi Glasser
publicComments.summary: A parent with children in the MI program since the pilot year advocated for investing resources in the program's long-term sustainability so parents don't have to choose between MI and North Star due to combo classes.

publicComments.name: Jasper Chen
publicComments.summary: An Orion parent praised Principal Winnie's leadership in building the MI program and urged the district to build the enrollment pipeline rather than creating compromises that might cause parents to question keeping their children in the program.

items.title: Labor Association Comments

publicComments.name: Maria Stockton
publicComments.summary: CSEA President asked the board to reinstate the calendar committee involving CSEA, RCTA, and district representatives so that classified staff have input on the school calendar start and end dates, noting that the current early-August start leaves no preparation time.
